simple.meaning: יַעֲנָה (yaʻănâh) is a Hebrew object word meaning “owl.” BibleIQ follows the concrete thing through the verses where it appears.

timeline.evidenceText: the horned owl, the screech owl, the gull, any kind of hawk,
the ostrich, the owl, the seagull, the hawk after its kind,
I am a brother to jackals,
But wild animals of the desert will lie there, and their houses will be full of jackals. Ostriches will dwell there, and wild goats will frolic there.
Thorns will come up in its palaces,
The animals of the field, the jackals and the ostriches, shall honor me,
Therefore the wild animals of the desert
For this I will lament and wail;
